market_expectation.revenue_growth_guidance: 18-22% FY27E (HSBC 21%); LFL challenged at low-single-digit; growth driven by store expansion (Zudio tier-2/3)
market_expectation.profitability_outlook: Margin pressure from input cost inflation (sourcing/raw materials) partially offset by operational leverage; 20-24% net profit growth FY27E
market_expectation.valuation_context: Large-cap at P/E 75-90x already pricing in significant Zudio re-rating; valuation weak relative to growth deceleration (Q1: 19% vs historic 30%+)
market_expectation.key_assumptions: Store expansion continues at ~20/quarter (80+/year); EBO/mall footprint optimized; middle-east supply chain normalized; commodity inflation moderates H2

management_guidance.store_expansion_target: 1,312 stores (as of June 2026) expanding to ~1,400+ by end FY27; Zudio pipeline strong (tier-2/3 cities); Westside selective (metro consolidation); total city coverage 330+ (up from 242 YoY)
management_guidance.capex_guidance: Capex directed at new store rollout (~Rs 80-100 cr/year estimated); EBO (exclusive brand outlet) optimization ongoing; focus on high-ROI tier-2/3 Zudio locations
management_guidance.lfl_sales_expectation: Low-single-digit LFL expected to persist through FY27 until tier-2/3 stores mature; macro headwinds + consumer spend moderation cited
management_guidance.cost_management: Input cost interventions via sourcing optimization and selective price increases; supply chain risks from Middle East disruptions flagged for H2; aiming to maintain EBITDA margin ~12%

market_expectation_summary: Market expects 18-22% revenue growth (vs 38.5% FY25, 19% Q1 FY27) as Zudio matures beyond metro tier-1; LFL bottleneck to persist until tier-2/3 cohorts stabilize (2-3yr horizon). Valuation at 75-90x P/E reflects peak-growth premium; multiple-compression risk if LFL remains sub-2% and capex ROI disappoints. Store productivity (Rs/sqft, basket size) key to unlocking value; EBO model critical as Westside slows.

four_box.note: FY25 rev +38.5% but Q1 FY27 decelerated to 19% YoY, LFL low-single-digit (Storyboard18/Business Standard); large-cap Mcap ~1.42L cr at P/E ~75-90x (gurufocus/tickertape) already prices in much of Zudio re-rating -> tam/valuation weak on size+multiple; large-cap named-inflection exception retained (Zudio Tier2/3 expansion still structurally intact) at Medium conviction, unconfirmed.
